stories.title: Follow live: Braves, Dodgers dueling in Game 4
Ravens acquire two-time Pro Bowl center Jurgens in trade with Eagles
stories.summary: The Ravens acquired two-time Pro Bowl center Cam Jurgens in a trade with the Eagles.

stories.title: NFL, union clarify celebration rules, say drinking gestures not violations
stories.summary: The NFL and NFLPA said recent player celebrations imitating drinking a beverage will no longer be violations or result in discipline. The sides also clarified what celebrations remain prohibited.

stories.title: Giants' Nabers doesn't practice, knee more 'sore' than usual
stories.summary: Giants star wide receiver Malik Nabers did not practice Wednesday because of a knee injury, saying only he was more "sore" than usual.

stories.title: Texans coach Ryans taking over defensive playcalling after 0-4 start
stories.summary: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Wednesday that he will be taking over the defensive playcalling duties amid his team's 0-4 start.
